title: Safer short links
description: A vague request. Shows ambiguity detection with blocking clarifying questions, a pause for stakeholder input, regeneration of the requirements (v2) from the answers, dynamic re-planning (a threat-model stage is inserted because the design is security sensitive), risk-based design approval and policy-driven approval of a configuration change.
requirement: Make our short links safer for the people who click them.

scriptedAnswers.Q1: Malicious or deceptive destination URLs (phishing, malware)
scriptedAnswers.Q2: Reject the link at creation time with a clear error
